# Bash-only: indexed arrays, readarray, and process substitution are not specified by POSIX sh.
readarray -t ${1:filtered} < <(for i in "${${2:myArray}[@]}"; do printf '%s\n' "\${i\}"; done | grep -e ${3|',"|}${4:pattern}${3} || [ $? -eq 1 ]) && wait "$!"
description: filter elements of an array based on given grep pattern
